lines.text: Join us on September 20 at Bergsen University for an inspiring day
dedicated to your health and wellbeing!
• Learn practical tips for boosting your energy and increasing your mental focus
• Chat with wellness professionals who specialize in student health.
• Access free resources to support your mental and physical well-being.
Registration and Coffee: Meet speakers and fellow students.
Keynote: Dr. Aisha Patel on "The Future of Student
Panel: "Mental Health in the Classroom" with David Chen,
Sofia Martinez, and Dr. Priya Nair
Panel: "Balancing Academics and Wellness" with Jamal
Robinson, Mei Lin, and Elena Petrova
Workshop: Nutrition and Fitness Tips for Busy Student Life
All sessions held in the Butler Wellness Center.
